A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' was the heir to the throne of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pavia]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and sought to engage in galactic politics against the [[Monarch of Pavia|current monarch's]] wishes. As a result, a galactic power arranged for the monarch's [[Death/Legends|death]] and for the heir's ascension to the throne.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Out With the Old}}</ref>
